messages:
Sam: Heads-up — CI is red on feature/stream-embed after my rebase. Failing tests: integration/serve_kernels_test::test_kernel_timeout and unit/kv_cache_test::test_cache_eviction
Maria: @Sam can you drop the PR link? I can kick off a targeted rerun.
Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4512 — rebased yesterday evening.
CI-bot: Build #4592 failed on linux-x86_64-shard-3 — logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4592 (exit 137 / segfault)
Lee: I saw a merge conflict touch in pkg/serve/runtime.c during the rebase, pinging @Ashika for runtime context.
Ashika: Pulled the branch locally, can't repro unit failures yet. Locally I'm seeing a segfault backtrace in runtime.c when running with valgrind: 
```
runtime: panic: nil pointer deref
goroutine 12 [running]:
  serve.runtime.step(0xc000...)
  /src/serve/runtime.c:423 +0x3b
```
Maria: That stack and exit 137 smells like a jemalloc / linker mismatch. Did main merge the jemalloc bump after your branch?
Sam: Yes — main merged #4490 (jemalloc bump + linker flags) after I branched off. I must have missed it during my rebase.
Jordan: Can someone run a targeted job instead of full CI? `cictl rerun --shard linux-x86_64-shard-3 --filter integration/serve_kernels_test`
Sam: Kicking off targeted rerun: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4595
CI-bot: Build #4595 started -> failed (same test, same segfault)
Lee: Confirmed same failure on shard-3. Requesting a bisect between origin/main@a1b2c3 and feature/stream-embed@d4e5f6 to isolate commit.
Ashika: I can do the bisect first thing tomorrow. In the meantime, can we try a temporary mitigation — pin the jemalloc version in the build matrix: `JEMALLOC_VERSION=5.2.1`?
Maria: For a quick unblock, can you push a revert of the build change that came from #4490 and re-run CI? We'll do a revert PR and then reintroduce once root cause is known.
Sam: Pushed a revert branch: feature/stream-embed/revert-jemalloc (compare: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/...)
CI-bot: Build #4598 triggered for feature/stream-embed/revert-jemalloc — status: SUCCESS ✅
Sam: Green on the revert branch. I'll open the revert PR with a note to re-add the jemalloc bump after we finish bisecting.
Ashika: I'll bisect tomorrow and report the offending commit. If bisect points to linker flags or jemalloc headers, we should add an integration gate in CI to catch this cross-build mismatch.
Maria: Agreed. @Sam please add a short CI profiling checklist to the PR description (how to reproduce cold-cache, which shard to run, extra env vars).
Sam: Will do. Thanks for the quick help everyone :thumbsup: 
CI-bot: Tip: to reproduce a cold-cache run locally, use `cictl run --cold-cache --shard linux-x86_64-shard-3 --filter integration/serve_kernels_test`
